Add the cod loin in pieces and cook for 6 minutes on low heat.

boeuf-miroton-oignons.title: Beef miroton with onions
steps: Cut the beef for braising into cubes and brown in a casserole with oil, then set aside.
Soften the sliced onions for 10 minutes, sprinkle with flour and add the vinegar.
Return the beef with tomato paste, stock cube, bay leaf and 50 cl of water, cover and simmer for 1 h 30.
Add the potatoes in pieces and cook for 25 minutes. Remove the bay leaf.

gratin-colin-chou-fleur.title: Hake and cauliflower gratin
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cook the cauliflower florets for 12 minutes in salted water and drain.
Prepare a béchamel with butter, flour and milk, add ground nutmeg.
Arrange the cauliflower and hake fillet pieces in a dish, cover with béchamel.
Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake for 20 minutes.

gratin-riz-courgettes-tomates.title: Rice gratin with zucchini and tomatoes
steps: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Cook the rice for 10 minutes in salted water and drain.
Sauté the sliced onion, chopped garlic (clove) and diced zucchini in oil for 10 minutes.
Add the chopped tomatoes and Provençal herbs, then mix with the rice in a dish.
Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake for 25 minutes.

tajine-poulet-citron-olives.title: Chicken tagine with lemon and olives
steps: Brown the chicken legs in oil with the sliced onion, crushed garlic (clove), grated fresh ginger and turmeric.
Pour in 30 cl of water, season with salt and pepper, cover and simmer for 25 minutes.
Add the potatoes in wedges and the lemon in thin slices, then cook covered for another 25 minutes.
Add the olives and chopped fresh coriander, reduce the sauce uncovered and serve.

couscous-legumes-pois-chiches.title: Vegetable couscous with chickpeas
steps: Sauté the sliced onion in 2 tablespoons of oil with ras el hanout.
Add the carrots in pieces, chopped tomatoes, 1 litre of water and salt, then cook for 20 minutes.
Add the zucchini in pieces and drained chickpeas, then cook for another 15 minutes.
Pour the same volume of boiling salted water with the remaining oil over the semolina, cover for 5 minutes, fluff with a fork and serve with the vegetables and their broth.

harira-agneau-lentilles.title: Harira with lamb and lentils
steps: Brown the lamb shoulder in small pieces with the sliced onion in oil, then add grated fresh ginger, turmeric and cinnamon.
Add the chopped tomatoes, rinsed lentils, 1.5 litres of water and salt, cover and simmer for 45 minutes.
Add the drained chickpeas, chopped fresh coriander and parsley, then cook for another 10 minutes.
Dissolve the cornstarch in a little cold water, pour in while stirring and let thicken for 2 minutes.
Serve hot with a squeeze of lemon juice.

loubia-haricots-blancs-tomate.title: Loubia, stewed white beans with tomato
steps: Sauté the sliced onion and crushed garlic (clove) in oil.
Add paprika, cumin, chili, chopped tomatoes, 20 cl of water and salt, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the drained and rinsed canned white beans and cook for another 10 minutes on low heat.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve.

tajine-boeuf-abricots-amandes.title: Beef tagine with dried apricots and flaked almonds
steps: Brown the beef for braising in large cubes in oil with the sliced onion, grated fresh ginger and cinnamon.
Cover with water to the level of the meat, season with salt, cover and simmer for 1 hour 30 minutes.
Add the dried apricots and honey, then cook uncovered for 20 minutes.
Toast the flaked almonds in a dry pan.
Soak the semolina with the same volume of boiling salted water, then serve the tagine sprinkled with almonds.

pastilla-poulet-amandes.title: Chicken and Almond Pastilla
steps: Cook the chicken with the sliced onion, fresh ginger, turmeric, salt and 30 cl water for 20 minutes, then shred the meat.
Reduce the cooking juices, cook the beaten eggs in it while stirring like scrambled eggs, then add the chicken and chopped fresh coriander.
Toast the ground almonds in a dry pan, then mix with the sugar and cinnamon, keeping 1 spoonful of this mixture aside.
Preheat the oven to 180 °C, melt the butter and line a round tin with 6 buttered brick pastry sheets, letting them hang over the edges.
Spread the almond mixture, then the filling, fold over the sheets, cover with the last 2 buttered sheets.
Bake for 25 minutes until the pastilla is golden and sprinkle with the reserved mixture.

colin-chermoula-pommes-de-terre.title: Hake with Chermoula and Potatoes
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C and blend the fresh coriander, garlic (clove), paprika, cumin, lemon juice, olive oil and salt.
Mix the potatoes sliced thinly with half of this chermoula in a dish and bake for 25 minutes.
Add the tomatoes in wedges and the fish, spoon over the rest of the chermoula.
Bake for 15 minutes, until the fish flakes easily.

mujaddara-lentilles-riz-oignons.title: Mujaddara, Lentils and Rice with Caramelized Onions
steps: Cook the rinsed lentils for 15 minutes in 80 cl water.
Slowly brown the sliced onion in olive oil over medium heat for 20 minutes, until very brown.
Add the rice, cumin, salt and pepper to the lentils and their water, topping up with water if needed, cover and cook for 15 minutes on low heat.
Let rest covered then serve topped with the onions.

chich-taouk-poulet-riz.title: Chich Taouk, Lebanese Marinated Chicken and Rice
steps: Mix the plain yogurt, lemon juice, crushed garlic (clove), tomato paste, paprika, 1 spoon of olive oil and salt.
Cut the chicken fillet into cubes, coat with this marinade and chill for 30 minutes.
Cook the rice.
Sear the chicken in the remaining oil over high heat for 10 minutes, turning, until well cooked and golden.
Serve with the rice.

colin-sauce-tahini-riz.title: Baked Hake, Lemon Tahini Sauce and Rice
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C and cook the rice.
Place the hake fillet in a dish, drizzle with olive oil, salt, sprinkle with cumin and bake for 15 minutes.
Mix the sesame paste, lemon juice, crushed garlic (clove) and 10 cl water until smooth.
Coat the fish with the sauce, bake for another 5 minutes and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve with the rice.

maghmour-aubergines-pois-chiches.title: Maghmour, Eggplant and Chickpeas in Tomato Sauce
steps: Preheat the oven to 220 °C, cut the eggplant into cubes, toss with 3 spoons of olive oil and bake for 25 minutes.
Sauté the sliced onion and crushed garlic (clove) in the remaining oil with cumin and chili.
Add the chopped tomatoes, drained chickpeas, eggplant and salt, then simmer for 20 minutes.
Sprinkle with chopped mint and serve hot or warm.

palak-tofu-epinards-riz.title: Palak with Tofu, Spiced Spinach and Rice
steps: Cook the rice and brown the firm tofu in cubes in 1 spoon of sunflower oil, then set aside.
Sauté the sliced onion, garlic (clove) and grated fresh ginger in the remaining sunflower oil with the spices.
Add the frozen spinach and salt and cook for 10 minutes.
Blend with the coconut milk, add the tofu and reheat for 5 minutes before serving with the rice.

aloo-gobi-chou-fleur-pommes-de-terre.title: Aloo Gobi, Cauliflower and Potatoes with Spices
steps: Sauté the sliced onion in sunflower oil with cumin, then add garlic (clove) and grated fresh ginger.
Add turmeric, garam masala, potatoes in cubes and cauliflower in florets.
Add diced tomatoes, salt and 15 cl water, cover and cook for 25 minutes on low heat.
Sprinkle with chopped fresh coriander and serve.

biryani-poulet-epices.title: Chicken Biryani with Spices
steps: Mix the chicken fillet in pieces with plain yogurt, crushed garlic (clove), grated fresh ginger, spices and half the salt, then chill for 20 minutes.
Brown the sliced onion in sunflower oil, keep half aside, then sear the chicken in the pan for 10 minutes.
Cook the rice for 6 minutes in a large pot of salted water and drain, it should remain firm.
Spread the rice over the chicken with raisins, chopped fresh coriander and mint and 10 cl water.
Cover tightly and cook on very low heat for 20 minutes, then serve with the reserved onion.

poulet-korma-amandes.title: Chicken Korma with Almonds
steps: Cook the rice and sauté the sliced onion in sunflower oil with garlic (clove) and grated fresh ginger.
Add the chicken fillet in pieces and the spices, then brown for 5 minutes.
Add ground almonds, 20 cl water and salt, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in the plain yogurt and single cream, reheat gently without boiling and serve with the rice.

keema-boeuf-petits-pois.title: Keema, Ground Beef with Peas and Spices
steps: Cook the rice and sauté the sliced onion in sunflower oil with garlic (clove) and grated fresh ginger.
Add the ground beef and spices and cook until the meat is well browned.
Add chopped tomatoes and salt and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the frozen peas, cook for 5 more minutes and serve with the rice.

crevettes-masala-tomate-riz.title: Shrimp Masala with Tomato and Rice
steps: Cook the rice and thaw the peeled shrimp, then drain well.
Sauté the sliced onion in sunflower oil with garlic (clove), grated fresh ginger and spices.
Add chopped tomatoes, coconut milk and salt, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the shrimp, cook for 5 minutes, sprinkle with chopped fresh coriander and serve with the rice.

pad-thai-crevettes.title: Shrimp Pad Thai
steps: Soak the rice vermicelli in hot water according to the package instructions, then drain.
Mix the tamari, nuoc mam, sugar, and the juice of one lime.
Sear the peeled shrimp and crushed garlic in the oil over high heat, then push to the side and scramble the eggs.
Add the rice vermicelli and sauce, mix for 3 minutes, then add the mung bean sprouts and sliced spring onion.
Serve with crushed peanuts and the other lime cut into wedges.

bibimbap-boeuf-legumes.title: Beef and Vegetable Bibimbap
steps: Cook the rice and cut the beef rump steak into thin strips, then mix with soy sauce, sugar, and crushed garlic.
Sauté separately in a little sesame oil the carrot sticks, sliced button mushrooms, then the fresh spinach.
Sear the beef for 2 minutes over high heat.
Fry the eggs.
Divide the rice into bowls, arrange the vegetables, beef, and egg, then sprinkle with sesame seeds and chili.

porc-caramel-vietnamien-oeufs.title: Vietnamese Caramel Pork with Eggs
steps: Cook the eggs for 9 minutes, peel them, and cook the rice.
Melt the sugar dry in a pot until you get an amber caramel, then carefully pour in 30 cl hot water.
Brown the pork tenderloin cubes in oil with sliced shallot and crushed garlic, then add the caramel and nuoc mam.
Simmer uncovered for 25 minutes, add the eggs and cook for another 5 minutes until the sauce is syrupy.
Add pepper and serve with the rice.

poulet-gong-bao-cacahuetes.title: Gong Bao Chicken with Peanuts
steps: Cook the rice and mix the diced chicken fillet with cornstarch and 1 spoonful of soy sauce.
Mix the rest of the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and 5 cl water.
Sear the chicken over high heat in oil for 5 minutes, then set aside.
Sauté the diced bell pepper, garlic, grated fresh ginger, and chili for 3 minutes.
Return the chicken, add the sauce, peanuts, and sliced spring onion, then serve with the rice.

mapo-tofu-boeuf.title: Mapo Tofu with Beef
steps: Cook the rice and cut the firm tofu into cubes.
Brown the ground beef in oil with crushed garlic, grated fresh ginger, and chili.
Add the soy sauce and 25 cl water, then the tofu, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Dissolve the cornstarch in a little cold water, pour in while stirring gently, and sprinkle with sliced spring onion before serving with the rice.

riz-saute-ananas-crevettes.title: Thai Fried Rice with Pineapple and Shrimp
steps: Cook the rice, spread it on a tray, and let it cool.
Sear the peeled shrimp in oil over high heat, then push to the side and scramble the eggs.
Add the rice, curry, tamari, and nuoc mam and stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Add the pineapple cut into small pieces, frozen peas, and sliced spring onion, cook for another 3 minutes, and serve immediately.

okonomiyaki-chou.title: Okonomiyaki, Japanese Cabbage Pancake
steps: Finely slice the white cabbage and spring onion.
Whisk the flour, eggs, and 12 cl water, then add the cabbage and spring onion.
Cook 2 large pancakes in oil over medium heat, 6 minutes on each side, covered.
Drizzle with soy sauce, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and serve immediately.

rendang-boeuf-coco.title: Beef Rendang with Coconut Milk
steps: Blend the onion, garlic, fresh ginger, turmeric, chili, and cinnamon into a paste.
Sauté this paste for 5 minutes in oil, then brown the beef for braising cut into cubes.
Toast the grated coconut dry, then add it with the coconut milk, 20 cl water, and salt.
Simmer uncovered for 2 hours over low heat, stirring occasionally, until the sauce is almost absorbed.
Drizzle with lime juice and serve with the rice.

saute-boeuf-brocoli.title: Beef Stir-Fry with Broccoli
steps: Cook the rice and blanch the broccoli florets for 3 minutes in boiling water.
Cut the beef rump steak into thin strips and mix with cornstarch and 1 spoonful of soy sauce.
Sear the beef for 2 minutes over high heat in oil with garlic and grated fresh ginger.
Add the broccoli, the rest of the soy sauce, sugar, and 5 cl water, mix for 2 minutes, and serve with the rice.

tinga-poulet-tostadas.title: Chicken Tinga on Tostadas
steps: Poach the chicken fillet for 15 minutes in simmering salted water, then shred.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C and bake the tortilla wraps for 6 minutes until crispy.
Sauté the sliced onion and garlic in oil, add paprika, chili, and chopped tomatoes, then cook for 10 minutes.
Add the chicken and mix for 3 minutes.
Top the tostadas with tinga, avocado slices, and a little thick crème fraîche.

enchiladas-haricots-rouges-four.title: Baked Enchiladas with Red Beans
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C and sauté the sliced onion and garlic in oil with cumin and paprika.
Add the chopped tomatoes and salt, cook for 10 minutes, then mix a third of this sauce with the red beans and drained canned corn.
Fill and roll the tortilla wraps, then pack them tightly in a dish.
Cover with the rest of the sauce, top with grated cheese, and bake for 20 minutes.

bol-burrito-riz-haricots-avocat.title: Burrito Bowl with Rice, Beans, and Avocado
steps: Cook the rice, then season with the juice of one lime and chopped fresh coriander.
Sauté the chopped onion in oil, add cumin, drained red beans, and 5 cl water, then reheat for 5 minutes.
Cut the tomatoes and avocados into cubes and drizzle with the juice of the other lime.
Divide the rice into bowls with the beans, drained canned corn, tomatoes, and avocado, season with salt, and serve.

arroz-rojo-poulet.title: Arroz rojo with chicken
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in a Dutch oven, then set aside.
Sauté the sliced onion, garlic and rice for 3 minutes in the same Dutch oven.
Add the chopped tomatoes, spices, salt, diced carrots, 50 cl water and the chicken.
Cover and cook for 25 minutes on low heat, adding a little water if needed.
Add the frozen peas, cook for another 5 minutes and serve.

pasta-alla-norma-aubergines-ricotta.title: Pasta alla norma with eggplant and ricotta
steps: Cut the eggplants into cubes and brown for 15 minutes in 3 tablespoons of olive oil.
Sauté the garlic in the remaining olive oil, add the chopped tomatoes and salt, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Cook the pasta and add the eggplant to the sauce.
Mix the pasta and sauce and serve topped with crumbled ricotta and basil.

pasta-e-fagioli-haricots-blancs.title: Pasta e fagioli with white beans
steps: Sauté the onion and diced carrot in olive oil with the crushed garlic.
Add the chopped tomatoes, oregano, salt and 1 litre water, then cook for 10 minutes.
Add the drained canned white beans and pasta and cook for the time indicated on the package, stirring often.
Let rest for 2 minutes and serve piping hot.

polenta-champignons-tomate.title: Creamy polenta with button mushrooms and tomato
steps: Sauté the sliced onion in 2 tablespoons of olive oil, then add the sliced button mushrooms and garlic and cook for 8 minutes.
Add the chopped tomatoes, oregano and half the salt, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Bring 1.2 litres of water to a boil with the remaining salt, pour in the polenta in a stream and cook, stirring, for the time indicated on the package.
Stir in the remaining olive oil and serve the polenta topped with the sauce.

piccata-dinde-citron-pates.title: Turkey piccata with lemon and pasta
steps: Cook the pasta and lightly flour the salted turkey escalopes.
Brown the escalopes for 4 minutes on each side in olive oil and half the butter, then set aside.
Pour the lemon juice and 10 cl water into the pan, scrape up the browned bits, then add the remaining butter.
Return the escalopes to the sauce for 1 minute, sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve with the pasta.

penne-arrabbiata.title: Penne all'arrabbiata
steps: Gently heat the olive oil with the sliced garlic and chili.
Add the chopped tomatoes and salt and simmer for 12 minutes.
Cook the pasta, drain and toss with the sauce.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve.

mafe-boeuf-cacahuete.title: Beef mafé with peanut butter
steps: Brown the beef cubes in oil with the sliced onion.
Add the chopped tomatoes, tomato paste, chili, salt and 50 cl water, then simmer for 45 minutes.
Mix the peanut butter with a little sauce, add it along with the carrots and sweet potatoes cut into large pieces.
Simmer for 30 minutes on low heat, stirring to prevent the sauce from sticking.
Cook the rice and serve with the mafé.

thieboudienne-cabillaud-riz.title: Thieboudienne with cod and tomato rice
steps: Blend the parsley, garlic, chili and half the salt, then rub the fish pieces with this mixture.
Sauté the sliced onion in oil, add the tomato paste and cook for 5 minutes, stirring.
Pour in 1 litre water, add the carrots, white cabbage and eggplant cut into large pieces and the remaining salt, then cook for 20 minutes.
Add the fish, cook for 10 minutes, then keep the fish and vegetables warm.
Add the rinsed rice to the broth, cover and cook for 20 minutes on low heat.
Serve the rice with the fish, vegetables and lemon wedges.

misir-wat-lentilles-corail.title: Misir wat, Ethiopian red lentils
steps: Sauté the chopped onion for 10 minutes in oil, then add the garlic and grated fresh ginger.
Add the paprika, chili, turmeric and tomato paste and stir for 2 minutes.
Add the rinsed red lentils, 80 cl water and salt, then simmer for 20 minutes, stirring.
Cook the rice and serve with the lentils.

jollof-riz-poulet.title: Jollof, tomato rice with chicken
steps: Brown the chicken in oil in a Dutch oven, then set aside.
Blend the chopped tomatoes, bell pepper, onion, garlic and fresh ginger.
Pour this mixture into the Dutch oven with tomato paste, curry, chili and salt, then cook for 10 minutes.
Add the rinsed rice, chicken and 40 cl water, cover and cook for 25 minutes on low heat, stirring once.
Let rest for 5 minutes covered and serve.

bricks-thon-oeuf-persil.title: Bricks with tuna and egg
steps: Mix the drained canned tuna and chopped parsley, then season with salt.
Place this mixture in the center of each brick pastry sheet, form a hollow and crack an egg into it.
Fold the pastry sheet into a triangle without breaking the egg.
Brown in hot oil for 2 minutes on each side, then drain on paper towels.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges.

salade-mechouia-poivrons-tomates.title: Mechouia salad, grilled bell peppers and tomatoes
steps: Preheat the oven to 230 °C and roast the whole bell peppers and tomatoes for 35 minutes, turning them.
Let cool covered, then peel and remove the seeds.
Chop the vegetables with the garlic.
Season with cumin, lemon juice, olive oil and salt, then garnish with olives and serve chilled.

zaalouk-aubergines-tomates.title: Zaalouk, eggplant and tomato caviar
steps: Cut the eggplants into small cubes and the tomatoes into dice.
Sauté the garlic in the oil with the spices.
Add the eggplants, tomatoes and salt, cover and cook 25 minutes over medium heat, stirring.
Mash with a fork, add the chopped fresh coriander and the lemon juice, then serve warm or cold.

carottes-cumin-citron-marocaines.title: Moroccan carrots with cumin and lemon
steps: Cook the carrots in slices for 10 minutes in salted water, they should stay firm, then drain.
Mix the crushed garlic, spices, lemon juice and oil.
Pour over the carrots, add the chopped parsley and serve chilled.

fattouch-pita-grillee.title: Fattoush, Lebanese salad with grilled pita
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C, cut the pita bread into pieces and bake for 8 minutes until crispy.
Cut the tomatoes, cucumber and radishes, chop the green salad and herbs.
Mix the lemon juice, oil and salt.
Combine everything at the last moment with the pita pieces and serve.

mouhammara-poivrons-noix.title: Muhammara, bell pepper and nut spread
steps: Preheat the oven to 230 °C and bake the whole bell peppers for 30 minutes, then peel and deseed them.
Blend the bell peppers with the nuts, breadcrumbs, tomato paste, garlic, cumin, chili and salt.
Add the lemon juice and oil, blend again and serve chilled.

baba-ghanouj-aubergines-tahini.title: Baba ghanouj, smoked eggplant with sesame paste
steps: Preheat the oven to 220 °C, prick the eggplants and bake them whole for 40 minutes.
Scoop out the flesh and let it drain in a colander.
Mash the flesh with the sesame paste, lemon juice, crushed garlic, cumin and salt.
Drizzle with oil, sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve chilled.

samoussas-legumes-four.title: Baked vegetable samosas
steps: Cook the potatoes in small cubes for 10 minutes in salted water, then drain.
Sauté the chopped onion in 1 spoon of oil with the garam masala, then add the potatoes, frozen peas and chopped fresh coriander.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C and cut each brick pastry sheet in half.
Fold each half-sheet into a triangle around a spoonful of filling, place on a baking tray and brush with the remaining oil.
Bake for 15 minutes, until the samosas are golden.

bhajis-oignons-pois-chiches.title: Onion bhajis with chickpea flour
steps: Finely slice the onions and chop the fresh coriander.
Mix the flour, spices, salt and about 12 cl water to get a thick batter, then add the onions and coriander.
Drop spoonfuls into hot oil and flatten slightly.
Cook 3 minutes on each side, drain on paper towels and serve hot.

rouleaux-printemps-crevettes.title: Shrimp spring rolls
steps: Cook the peeled shrimp for 3 minutes in boiling water, then drain, and soak the rice vermicelli according to the package.
Grate the carrots and chop the green salad.
Dip a rice paper sheet for a few seconds in lukewarm water and place it on a damp towel.
Fill with green salad, vermicelli, carrots, herbs and shrimp, then roll tightly, folding in the sides.
Mix the nuoc mam, lime juice, sugar and 3 spoons of water and serve as a dipping sauce.

salade-mangue-crevettes-citron-vert.title: Mango and shrimp salad with lime
steps: Sear the shrimp for 3 minutes in oil, then let cool.
Cut the mango and cucumber into dice.
Mix the juice of the limes, nuoc mam and chili.
Combine everything with the chopped fresh coriander and serve chilled.

soupe-coco-poulet-citron-vert.title: Thai soup with chicken, coconut and lime
steps: Bring the coconut milk to a simmer with 50 cl water, the fresh ginger in slices and the chili.
Add the chicken in thin slices and the sliced button mushrooms, then cook for 10 minutes.
Add the nuoc mam, sugar and lime juice.
Sprinkle with chopped fresh coriander and serve.

guacamole-chips-tortilla.title: Guacamole and tortilla chips
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C, cut the tortilla wraps into triangles, brush with oil and bake for 8 minutes.
Mash the avocados with a fork with the lime juice and salt.
Add the tomato in small dice, finely chopped onion and chopped fresh coriander.
Serve immediately with the chips.

esquites-mais-citron-vert.title: Esquites, sautéed corn with lime
steps: Brown the drained canned corn in the butter for 6 minutes over high heat.
Off the heat, add the thick crème fraîche, lime juice, paprika and salt.
Divide into small bowls, crumble the feta and sprinkle with chopped fresh coriander.

caponata-aubergines-olives.title: Sicilian Caponata with Eggplant and Olives
steps: Brown the eggplant cubes in 3 tablespoons of oil for 15 minutes, then set aside.
Sauté the sliced onion in the remaining oil, add the chopped tomatoes and salt, and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the eggplant, olives, sugar, and vinegar, then cook for another 10 minutes.
Let cool, add the basil, and serve at room temperature.

panzanella-tomates-pain.title: Panzanella, Tuscan Tomato and Bread Salad
steps: Cut the day-old baguette into cubes.
Cut the tomatoes and cucumber into pieces and slice the onion thinly, then mix them with the salt.
Add the bread, vinegar, and oil, mix, and let sit for 10 minutes so the bread soaks up the juices.
Add the basil and serve.

minestrone-legumes-haricots.title: Minestrone with Vegetables and White Beans
steps: Sauté the chopped onion and garlic (clove) in oil.
Add the diced carrots and potatoes, chopped tomatoes, salt, and 1.2 liters of water, then cook for 15 minutes.
Add the diced zucchini, chopped green beans, and drained canned white beans, then cook for another 15 minutes.
Add the chopped basil and serve.

salade-concombre-sesame.title: Cucumber Salad with Sesame
steps: Lightly crush the cucumbers, then cut them into irregular pieces.
Mix the tamari, vinegar, sesame oil, sugar, crushed garlic (clove), and chili.
Toss with the cucumbers, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and serve chilled.

kachumbari-tomates-oignon.title: Kachumbari, East African Tomato and Onion Salad
steps: Slice the onion very thinly and let it sit for 5 minutes in the lime juice with salt.
Dice the tomatoes and cucumber into small pieces.
Mix everything with the chopped fresh coriander and chili, then serve chilled.

soupe-arachide-patate-douce.title: West African Peanut and Sweet Potato Soup
steps: Sauté the sliced onion in oil with garlic (clove) and grated fresh ginger.
Add the cubed sweet potatoes, chopped tomatoes, chili, salt, and 1 liter of water, then cook for 20 minutes.
Add the peanut butter and blend until you get a smooth soup.
Reheat for 2 minutes while stirring and serve.

mouhalabieh-fleur-oranger-pistache.title: Mouhalabieh with Orange Blossom Water and Pistachios
steps: Dissolve the cornstarch in 10 cl of cold milk.
Bring the rest of the milk to a simmer with the sugar, pour in the cornstarch mixture, and stir for 3 minutes until thickened.
Off the heat, add the orange blossom water and pour into small bowls.
Let set for 2 hours in the fridge and sprinkle with crushed shelled pistachios.

salade-oranges-cannelle.title: Orange Salad with Cinnamon
steps: Peel the oranges and cut them into thin slices.
Arrange them on a platter and drizzle with orange blossom water.
Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon, then top with chopped mint and serve chilled.

ghribas-noix-de-coco.title: Coconut Ghribas
steps: Preheat the oven to 170 °C.
Mix the grated coconut, semolina, sugar, vanilla sugar, baking powder, and eggs, then let rest for 10 minutes.
Form balls, place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and flatten them slightly.
Bake for 15 minutes until just golden and let cool on the baking sheet.

baklava-noix-miel.title: Baklava with Nuts and Honey
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C, roughly chop the nuts with the sugar and cinnamon, and melt the butter.
Cut the brick pastry sheets to fit a small baking dish, then alternate buttered sheets and nuts, finishing with a sheet.
Cut into diamonds and bake for 25 minutes until the top is golden.
Heat the honey with the lemon juice and 5 cl of water, then pour over the hot baklava.
Let rest for several hours before serving.

gajar-halwa-carottes-pistaches.title: Gajar Halwa, Indian Carrot Dessert
steps: Finely grate the carrots.
Cook them for 25 minutes in the milk, stirring, until the milk is absorbed.
Add the sugar, butter, cinnamon, and raisins, then cook for 8 minutes until the mixture pulls away from the sides of the pan.
Serve warm, sprinkled with crushed shelled pistachios.

riz-coco-mangue.title: Rice with Coconut Milk and Mango
steps: Rinse the rice, then cook it for 20 minutes over low heat with the coconut milk, 30 cl of water, sugar, and salt, stirring often.
Let rest for 10 minutes covered.
Slice the mango and serve over the warm rice.

che-bananes-coco.title: Chè, Vietnamese Bananas with Coconut Milk
steps: Bring the coconut milk to a simmer with 20 cl water and the sugar.
Add the bananas in slices and cook for 5 minutes.
Dissolve the cornstarch in a little cold water, pour in while stirring and let thicken for 1 minute.
Serve warm, sprinkled with sesame seeds.

churros-four-cannelle.title: Oven-Baked Churros with Cinnamon
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C and bring 25 cl water to a boil with the butter and salt.
Off the heat, add the flour all at once, stir vigorously, then dry out for 1 minute over low heat.
Incorporate the eggs one by one until you get a smooth dough.
Pipe sticks onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 22 minutes.
Roll the hot churros in the sugar mixed with cinnamon and serve immediately.

flan-caramel-oeufs.title: Egg and Caramel Flan
steps: Preheat the oven to 160 °C and melt 80 g sugar dry until you get an amber caramel, then pour it into a mold.
Warm the milk with the vanilla sugar.
Whisk the eggs with the remaining sugar, then pour in the milk while stirring.
Pour over the caramel, place the mold in a dish of hot water and bake for 40 minutes.
Let cool, chill for 3 hours and unmold.

panna-cotta-fruits-rouges-agar.title: Panna Cotta with Agar-Agar and Berries
steps: Mix the single cream, milk, 40 g sugar, vanilla sugar and agar-agar cold.
Bring to a boil and let boil for 2 minutes, stirring.
Divide into glasses, let cool, then chill for 2 hours.
Cook the frozen berries for 5 minutes with the remaining sugar, let cool and spoon over the panna cottas.

tiramisu-cafe-classique.title: Classic Coffee Tiramisu
steps: Dissolve the instant coffee in 25 cl hot water and let cool.
Whisk the yolks with the sugar until the mixture whitens, then fold in the mascarpone.
Beat the egg whites until stiff and gently fold them in.
Quickly dip the shortbread biscuits in the coffee and layer in a dish with the cream.
Chill for 4 hours and dust with cocoa before serving.

thiakry-semoule-yaourt.title: Thiakry, Sweet Semolina with Yogurt
steps: Pour 20 cl boiling water over the semolina, cover for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.
Mix the plain yogurts, milk, sugar, vanilla sugar and cinnamon.
Add the semolina and raisins, mix and chill for 1 hour.
Sprinkle with grated coconut and serve cold.

ananas-gingembre-citron-vert.title: Fresh Pineapple with Ginger and Lime
steps: Peel the pineapple, remove the core and cut the flesh into small pieces.
Mix the grated fresh ginger, the zest and juice of the lime and the sugar.
Pour over the pineapple, add chopped mint and serve cold.

gateau-cacao-vegan.title: Vegan Cocoa Cake
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and grease a pan.
Mix the flour, cocoa powder, sugar, vanilla sugar, baking powder and salt.
Add the sunflower oil, vinegar and 20 cl water, then whisk just until smooth.
Pour into the pan, bake for 30 minutes and let cool slightly before unmolding.

shrikhand-yaourt-mangue.title: Shrikhand, Drained Yogurt with Mango
steps: Pour the plain yogurts into a sieve lined with a clean cloth and let drain for 3 hours in the fridge.
Mix the drained yogurt with the sugar and cinnamon.
Divide into bowls, add diced mango and chopped shelled pistachios.

baghrir-crepes-mille-trous.title: Baghrir, Moroccan Thousand-Hole Pancakes
steps: Blend the semolina, flour, sugar, salt, both yeasts and 45 cl lukewarm water for 1 minute.
Let the batter rest for 30 minutes at room temperature, until it foams.
Pour a small ladleful into a hot non-stick pan and cook without flipping until the top is dry and covered with holes.
Melt the butter with the honey and drizzle over the pancakes.

foul-feves-citron-cumin.title: Foul, Fava Beans with Lemon and Cumin
steps: Reheat the drained canned fava beans for 8 minutes with 10 cl water.
Roughly mash with the crushed garlic (clove), cumin, salt and lemon juice.
Serve drizzled with olive oil, with diced tomato and chopped parsley.

pita-zaatar-huile-olive.title: Pitas with Zaatar and Raw Vegetables
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C and mix the zaatar with the olive oil.
Spread this mixture on the pita bread and bake for 6 minutes.
Serve hot with sliced tomato and cucumber and mint.

upma-semoule-legumes.title: Upma, savory semolina with vegetables
steps: Toast the semolina dry for 3 minutes in a pan, then set aside.
Sauté the cumin, chopped onion, diced carrot, and grated fresh ginger in oil.
Add the frozen peas, turmeric, salt, and 55 cl water, then bring to a boil.
Sprinkle in the semolina, stir for 2 minutes, cover off the heat for 3 minutes, and drizzle with lemon juice.

omelette-masala-tomate.title: Masala omelette with tomato
steps: Beat the eggs with salt and spices.
Add the chopped onion, diced tomato, and chopped fresh coriander.
Cook in oil over medium heat in two batches, folding the omelette while still slightly runny.

congee-riz-poulet-gingembre.title: Congee, rice porridge with chicken and ginger
steps: Bring the rinsed rice to a boil with 2 liters of water, sliced fresh ginger, salt, and the whole chicken fillet.
Simmer for 15 minutes, remove the chicken, and shred it.
Continue cooking the rice for 35 minutes on low heat, stirring, until you get a porridge.
Return the chicken and serve with tamari, sesame oil, and sliced spring onion.

tamagoyaki-omelette-roulee.title: Tamagoyaki, Japanese rolled omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with sugar, tamari, and sliced spring onion.
Pour a thin layer into an oiled pan over medium heat, then roll the omelette to one side when set.
Pour another layer under the roll and repeat until finished.
Let cool slightly and cut into slices.

huevos-rancheros-haricots.title: Huevos rancheros with red beans
steps: Sauté the chopped onion and garlic (clove) in oil, add the chopped tomatoes, cumin, chili, and salt, then cook for 8 minutes.
Add the drained red beans and reheat.
Make 4 wells in the sauce, crack in the eggs, cover, and cook for 5 minutes.
Warm the tortilla wraps in a pan, top with sauce and an egg, then sprinkle with chopped fresh coriander.

frittata-legumes-four.title: Vegetable frittata
steps: Preheat the oven to 190 °C.
Sauté the onion, bell pepper, and zucchini diced for 8 minutes in oil in an ovenproof pan.
Beat the eggs with salt and chopped basil, then pour over the vegetables.
Cook for 2 minutes on the stove, then bake for 12 minutes.

tartines-ricotta-miel-fraises.title: Ricotta toasts with honey and strawberries
steps: Slice the baguette in half lengthwise, then into pieces.
Spread with ricotta.
Top with sliced strawberries and drizzle with honey.

porridge-arachide-banane.title: Peanut butter and banana porridge
steps: Bring the soy drink to a simmer with cinnamon.
Add the oat flakes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring.
Off the heat, stir in the peanut butter.
Serve with sliced bananas.

chia-coco-mangue.title: Chia pudding with coconut and mango
steps: Mix the coconut milk, 20 cl water, sugar, and chia seeds.
Stir again after 10 minutes and chill overnight.
Blend the mango with the juice of the lime.
Serve the pudding with the mango purée.

tofu-brouille-tomate-curcuma.title: Scrambled tofu with tomato and turmeric
steps: Crumble the firm tofu with a fork.
Sauté the sliced spring onion in oil, add turmeric and paprika.
Add the tofu, diced tomato, and salt, then cook for 6 minutes, stirring.

smoothie-mangue-banane-coco.title: Mango, banana and coconut smoothie
steps: Peel the mango and bananas and cut into pieces.
Blend with coconut milk, lime juice, and 30 cl very cold water.
Serve immediately.

puff-puff-beignets.title: Puff-puff, West African doughnuts
steps: Mix the flour, sugar, dried baker's yeast, salt, and 20 cl lukewarm water until you get a thick, sticky dough.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour in a warm place.
Heat oil to a depth of 3 cm in a deep saucepan.
Drop spoonfuls of dough into the oil and fry for 5 minutes, turning, until golden.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm.

salade-lyonnaise-complete.title: Complete Lyonnaise salad
steps: Boil the potatoes whole in salted water, then peel them and slice into thick rounds.
Brown the bacon bits dry in a frying pan, add the slices of country bread and toast them on both sides.
Poach the eggs in simmering water with added vinegar for 3 minutes, then drain them.
Make the vinaigrette with the chopped shallot, mustard, vinegar, olive oil, salt and pepper. Arrange the salad with the potatoes, bacon bits, croutons and eggs, then spoon over the vinaigrette.

oeufs-en-meurette.title: Eggs in red wine sauce
steps: Sauté the bacon bits, the sliced onion and the chopped shallot in the butter for 5 minutes.
Pour in the red wine, add the crushed garlic, the bay leaf, the dried thyme and the button mushrooms cut into quarters, then simmer for 20 minutes.
Poach the eggs in simmering water with vinegar for 3 minutes and drain them.
Toast the slices of country bread, place them on plates, set the eggs on top, spoon over the sauce, season with salt and pepper and serve.

poireaux-vinaigrette-jambon.title: Leeks with vinaigrette and ham
steps: Clean the leeks, halve them lengthwise and cook them in salted water for 20 minutes.
Cook the hard eggs in a saucepan of simmering water for 9 minutes, then shell them.
Make the vinaigrette with mustard, vinegar, olive oil, salt, pepper and the chopped parsley.
Drain the leeks, arrange them on a dish, spoon over the vinaigrette, add the slices of cooked ham and the eggs cut into quarters.

aligot-saucisse-comte.title: Aligot with comté and sausages
steps: Peel the potatoes, cut them into pieces and cook them in salted water with the whole garlic cloves for 25 minutes.
Cook the sausages in a frying pan over medium heat for 15 minutes, turning them regularly.
Mash the potatoes and the cooked garlic, then incorporate the butter and the single cream to obtain a smooth purée.
Add the grated comté little by little into the hot purée and stir over low heat until it forms strands. Season with salt and pepper and serve with the sausages.

pommes-sarladaises-cuisse-canard.title: Duck legs with pommes sarladaises
steps: Cook the duck legs skin-side down in a frying pan over medium heat for 25 minutes to render the fat, then set them aside.
Peel the potatoes, cut them into thick slices and brown them in the duck fat with the chopped garlic, the thyme and the salt for 20 minutes.
Return the legs on top of the potatoes, cover and continue cooking over low heat for 15 minutes.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley, grind over some pepper and serve piping hot.

saltimbocca-dinde-jambon.title: Turkey saltimbocca with ham and white wine
steps: Flatten the turkey escalopes between two sheets of baking paper, then season them with salt and pepper.
Place a slice of cooked ham on each escalope and sprinkle with provençal herbs.
Heat the olive oil and 15 g of butter, then sear the escalopes on the ham side for 3 minutes, turn and cook for another 2 minutes.
Remove the escalopes, deglaze the pan with the dry white wine and reduce by half for 4 minutes.
Return the escalopes to the sauce, add the remaining butter, adjust the seasoning and serve immediately.

osso-buco-veau-gremolata.title: Veal osso buco with gremolata
steps: Coat the veal pieces in flour, then season them with salt and pepper.
Brown the pieces in hot oil for 8 minutes, then set them aside.
Sauté the onion, carrot and one sliced garlic clove for 5 minutes in the same pot.
Deglaze with dry white wine, add the chopped tomatoes and the crumbled stock cube, return the veal, cover and simmer gently for 1 h 30.
Chop the parsley with the lemon zest and the second garlic clove, then sprinkle over the dish before serving.

arancini-jambon-mozzarella.title: Arancini with ham and mozzarella
steps: Sauté the sliced onion in butter, add the rice and toast for 2 minutes.
Add the hot stock little by little and cook the rice for 18 minutes, stirring, until tender.
Let the rice cool, then stir in the parmesan, one beaten egg and the salt.
Shape balls of rice around a cube of mozzarella and ham, then coat them in flour, the remaining beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry the arancini in hot oil for 4 minutes until well golden, then drain on kitchen paper.

cannelloni-poulet-poivrons.title: Chicken and bell pepper cannelloni
steps: Cook the lasagna sheets for 8 minutes in a large pot of boiling salted water, then drain them.
Sauté the onion and garlic in oil for 4 minutes, add the chicken and diced bell peppers, then cook for another 10 minutes.

Off the heat, mix the filling with the ricotta, half the parmesan, salt and pepper. Fill each sheet with the mixture and roll. Spread the chopped tomatoes in the bottom of a dish and arrange the cannelloni in it.
Sprinkle with mozzarella and the remaining parmesan, then bake at 190 °C for 25 minutes.

pollo-al-ajillo.title: Spanish garlic chicken (pollo al ajillo)
steps: Season the chicken legs with salt and pepper, then brown them in olive oil for 8 min.
Add the garlic slices and the chili, sauté for 1 min without letting the garlic burn.
Deglaze with dry white wine, cover and simmer gently for 25 min.
Sprinkle with paprika and chopped parsley, then serve hot.

gambas-al-ajillo.title: Garlic and chili prawns (gambas al ajillo)
steps: Heat the olive oil with the sliced garlic and the chili over low heat for 2 min.
Add the shrimp and sear over high heat for 3 min until pink.
Season with salt, sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve immediately with the baguette sliced.

fabada-asturienne-simplifiee.title: Simplified Asturian fabada
steps: Sauté the sliced onion and garlic in olive oil for 5 min.
Add the salted pork, chorizo and smoked pork sausage cut into pieces, then brown for 4 min.
Pour in 1 litre of stock prepared with the cubes, add the bay leaf and the paprika, then simmer gently for 30 min.
Add the drained white beans, continue cooking at a low simmer for 15 min, then serve.

croquetas-de-jambon.title: Spanish ham croquetas
steps: Melt the butter, add the flour and cook for 2 min, stirring.
Pour in the milk little by little while whisking, add the chopped cooked ham and ground nutmeg, then cook for 5 min until you have a thick cream.
Spread the mixture on an oiled dish and chill for at least 2 h in the refrigerator.
Shape small oblong balls, dip them in the beaten egg then in the breadcrumbs.
Fry the croquetas in very hot sunflower oil for 3 min until golden, then drain.

cocido-madrileno.title: Simplified cocido madrileño
steps: Place the beef for braising, the onion, the garlic and the bay leaf in 2 litres of stock prepared with the stock cubes, then simmer for 90 min.
Add the carrots, the leek and the potatoes cut up, then cook for 30 min.
Add the whole chorizo, the drained chickpeas and the savoy cabbage in pieces, then cook for 20 min.
Serve the stock, the meats and the vegetables cut on a large platter, accompanied by mustard if desired.

pisto-manchego-aux-oeufs.title: Pisto manchego with eggs
steps: Sauté the sliced onion and the garlic in olive oil for 5 min.
Add the diced bell pepper, eggplant and zucchini, then cook for 15 min over medium heat.
Add the diced tomatoes and the salt, cover and simmer for 20 min.
Make 4 wells in the pisto, break an egg into each, cover and cook for 6 min until the whites are set.

migas-extremenas.title: Migas extremeñas with chorizo
steps: Crumble the country bread, drizzle with stock diluted with the cube and let rest for 15 min.
Brown the bacon bits and the chorizo cut into cubes in the olive oil for 4 min.
Add the crushed garlic, the diced bell pepper and the paprika, then cook for 3 min.
Add the drained crumbs and stir for 10 min until they become crispy and golden.

empanada-galicienne-au-thon.title: Galician empanada with tuna
steps: Sauté the sliced onion and bell pepper in olive oil for 10 min over low heat.
Add the crushed garlic, the diced tomato and the paprika, then cook for 10 min until reduced.
Off the heat, fold in the drained canned tuna and let the filling cool.
Roll out one pastry on a baking tray, fill, cover with the second pastry, seal the edges, brush with the beaten egg then bake for 30 min.

agneau-asado-espagnol.title: Spanish roasted lamb shoulder (cordero asado)
steps: Rub the lamb shoulder with the crushed garlic, the paprika, the herbs, the salt and the olive oil, then let marinate for 30 min.
Place the lamb shoulder in a dish with the potatoes in wedges, the sliced onion and the dry white wine, then cover.
Roast at 160 °C and cook for 2 h 30, basting from time to time.
Carve the lamb shoulder and serve with the potatoes and the cooking juices.

porc-adobado-pommes-de-terre-roties.title: Marinated pork and roasted potatoes
steps: Mix paprika, crushed garlic, vinegar, olive oil, oregano and salt, coat the pork tenderloin with the mixture and let rest for 1 h.
Sear the pork on all sides in a hot pan for 8 min.
Cut the potatoes into wedges, arrange them around the pork in a baking dish, then bake at 200 °C for 25 min.

bacalao-al-pil-pil.title: Cod pil-pil with potatoes
steps: Steam the peeled potatoes for 20 min, then keep them warm.
Gently confit the sliced garlic and chili in olive oil over very low heat for 5 min.
Place the salted cod loin in the oil, skin side up, and cook 4 min on each side over low heat.
Remove the fish, emulsify the cooking oil by shaking it off the heat, add chopped parsley, then spoon the sauce over the fish and serve with the potatoes.

arroz-al-horno-chorizo-pois-chiches.title: Oven-baked rice with chorizo and chickpeas
steps: Sauté the sliced onion, crushed garlic and diced chorizo in olive oil for 6 min.
Add the rice, tomato paste and paprika, then mix for 1 min.
Pour in the hot stock prepared with the 2 cubes (about 600 ml), add the drained chickpeas and the frozen peas, transfer to a dish and bake at 200 °C for 25 min.
Let rest for 5 min out of the oven before serving.

kibbeh-au-four-boulgour-viande.title: Baked kibbeh with bulgur and meat
steps: Soak the bulgur in cold water for 20 minutes, then squeeze it out thoroughly.
Sauté the sliced onion in half of the olive oil, add the ground beef, cinnamon, ground nutmeg, salt and pepper, then cook until well done.
Spread half the bulgur over the bottom of an oiled dish, cover with the meat, then top with the remaining bulgur, smoothing and scoring it with a knife.
Sprinkle with flaked almonds, drizzle with the remaining oil and bake at 190 °C for 30 minutes until the top is golden.

makloubeh-au-poulet-riz-renverse.title: Makloubeh with chicken and inverted rice
steps: Brown the chicken legs with the sliced onions, then add the chopped tomatoes, turmeric, cumin, cinnamon, salt and pepper, and simmer.
Separately fry the eggplant slices, potato rounds and cauliflower florets in oil until colored.
Rinse the rice, spread it in the pot over the chicken, pour in hot stock to cover, then cook over low heat with the lid on.
Arrange the fried vegetables over the rice, invert the pot onto a warm platter and let rest before carving.

sayadieh-au-cabillaud-riz-aux-oignons.title: Sayadieh with cod and onion rice
steps: Caramelize the sliced onions in olive oil over medium heat for 20 minutes, then set aside half of them.
Toast the flaked almonds dry in a pan for 3 minutes until golden.
Cook the cod loins in the hot stock with cumin, turmeric, salt and pepper for 10 minutes, then keep them warm.
Cook the rice in the flavored cooking stock, covered, until fully absorbed, then plate the rice, the fish, the remaining onions and the almonds, with the lemon cut into quarters.

briouates-a-la-viande-et-aux-amandes.title: Meat and almond briouats
steps: Sauté the chopped onion in olive oil, add the ground beef, cinnamon, ras el hanout, salt and pepper, then cook until the mixture is dry.
Mix the filling with the flaked almonds, chopped parsley and fresh coriander, then let cool.
Cut the brick pastry sheet in half, fill each half, fold into a triangle sealing the edge with beaten egg, then brush with melted butter.
Bake the briouats at 190 °C for 20 minutes until well golden and crispy.

shawarma-de-dinde-en-assiette-sauce-tahi.title: Turkey shawarma plate with tahini sauce
steps: Cut the turkey escalope into thin strips and marinate for 30 minutes with olive oil, paprika, cumin, turmeric, one crushed garlic clove, the juice of the lemon, salt and pepper.
Sear the turkey in a very hot pan for 8 minutes, browning it on all sides.
Mix the plain yogurt, sesame paste, the juice of half a lemon and the other crushed garlic clove to obtain a smooth sauce.
Warm the pita bread, then arrange the turkey with the tomato, the cucumber and the green salad, and drizzle with tahini sauce.

poulet-tandoori-riz-cumin.title: Tandoori chicken with cumin rice
steps: Mix the plain yogurt, the juice of the lemon, the crushed garlic, grated fresh ginger, paprika, garam masala, cumin, salt and the oil in a bowl.
Score the chicken leg, coat with the marinade and let marinate in the fridge.
Place the legs on a tray lined with baking paper and cook in the oven until well browned and cooked through.
Rinse the rice, cook it in salted water with the cumin for 12 minutes, then drain.
Sprinkle with fresh coriander and serve the legs with the rice.

butter-chicken-maison.title: Homemade butter chicken with cream and spices
steps: Mix the plain yogurt, half the garam masala, paprika, salt and the crushed garlic, then coat the chicken cut into cubes.
Sauté the chicken in 20 g of butter for 6 minutes, then set aside.
Melt the remaining butter, sauté the sliced onion and grated fresh ginger, then add the chopped tomatoes, the rest of the garam masala and simmer for 15 minutes.
Pour in the single cream, return the chicken and simmer for 10 minutes over low heat.
Cook the rice in salted water for 12 minutes and serve it with the chicken.

boeuf-basilic-thai-oeuf.title: Thai basil beef stir-fry with fried egg
steps: Cook the rice in a large pot of salted water for 15 minutes, then keep warm.
Finely chop the garlic and the chili, slice the onion, cut the bell pepper into strips and the green beans into pieces.
Heat the sunflower oil and sear the ground beef with the onion, garlic and chili for 5 minutes over high heat.
Add the bell pepper and the green beans, then the nuoc mam, soy sauce and sugar. Cook for 4 minutes, then remove from heat and stir in the basil.
Fry the eggs in an oiled pan until the whites are set and the yolks runny, then serve on the stir-fry with the rice.

oyakodon-poulet-oeuf.title: Oyakodon with chicken and eggs
steps: Cook the rice in a covered pot, then keep warm.
Cut the chicken into pieces, slice the onion and sauté together over medium heat until the chicken is no longer pink.
Dissolve the stock cube in 150 ml of water, add the soy sauce and the sugar, pour over the chicken and simmer for 5 minutes.
Beat the eggs, pour them in two stages over the mixture and cover for 1 minute so they remain slightly runny. Serve immediately over the rice.

bulgogi-boeuf-poire.title: Beef bulgogi with pear, onions, rice and cucumber
steps: Blend the pear, the onion, the garlic and the fresh ginger, then mix with the soy sauce, the sugar and the sesame oil.
Cut the beef into thin slices, mix them with the marinade and let rest in the refrigerator.
Sear the meat for 3 minutes over high heat in a very hot pan, in batches if necessary.
Cook the rice, thinly slice the spring onions and the cucumber, then serve the meat over the rice and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

tonkatsu-porc-chou.title: Crispy pork tonkatsu with shredded cabbage
steps: Flatten the pork tenderloin between two sheets of paper, then season with salt and pepper.
Coat each cutlet in the flour, then in the beaten egg, and finally in the breadcrumbs, pressing lightly.
Fry the cutlets in hot sunflower oil for 8 minutes in total, turning them, until the meat is no longer pink.
Drain on paper towels. Finely shred the white cabbage, mix the soy sauce, the vinegar and the sugar, then serve the cutlets sliced over the cabbage with this sauce.

sundubu-jjigae-tofu.title: Spicy Korean tofu soup with egg
steps: Sauté the chopped onion, the garlic and the fresh ginger in the sesame oil for 3 minutes.
Add the chili and the sliced button mushrooms, then pour in 1.2 liters of water with the stock cube dissolved and the soy sauce. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the firm tofu cut into cubes and simmer for 3 minutes.
Crack the eggs into the simmering soup, cover for 2 minutes, then garnish with the sliced spring onions and serve.

sopa-tortilla-poulet-avocat.title: Tortilla soup with chicken and avocado
steps: Cut the tortilla wrap into strips, then brown them in the hot oil for 3 minutes. Set aside.
In the same oil, sauté the sliced onion and the garlic, then add the chicken fillet diced, the cumin and the paprika. Cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in the chopped tomatoes, the crumbled stock cube and 1 liter of water. Simmer for 15 minutes over medium heat.
Season with salt, then serve in bowls with the tortilla strips, the avocado diced, the grated cheese, the chopped fresh coriander and a squeeze of lime.

mole-poblano-simplifie-poulet.title: Simplified mole poblano with chicken and rice
steps: Season the chicken leg with salt and pepper, then brown in the hot oil for 8 minutes. Set aside.

In the same casserole, sauté the sliced onion and the garlic, then add the sesame seeds, the ground almonds, the cinnamon, the chili, the cocoa powder, the tomato paste and the chopped tomatoes. Cook for 5 minutes.
Blend the sauce, return it to the casserole with the stock cube dissolved in 500 ml of water and the chopped dark chocolate. Add the chicken and simmer covered for 35 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the rice in salted water for 15 minutes.
Serve the chicken topped with mole alongside the rice.

cochinita-pibil-simplifiee.title: Simplified cochinita pibil with tortillas and radish
steps: Blend the garlic, the paprika, the cumin, the oregano, the pepper, the salt, the olive oil, the orange juice and the lime juice.
Rub the pork shoulder with the marinade, cover and let rest for 1 hour in the refrigerator.
Place the pork shoulder, the sliced onion and the orange slices in a dish, cover with aluminum foil and cook in the oven at 150 °C.
Shred the meat with a fork and mix it with the cooking juices.
Reheat the tortilla wrap in a dry pan for 2 minutes.
Fill the tortillas with the pork, the sliced radish and the chopped fresh coriander, then serve.

pozole-rouge-porc-mais.title: Red pozole with pork, corn and radish
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic in oil for 4 minutes.
Add the pork pieces, paprika, cumin, chili and tomato paste. Brown for 5 minutes.
Pour in 1.5 litres of water, the stock, the drained corn and the oregano. Cook covered for 1 hour 30 at low heat.
Season with salt. Serve hot with finely shredded white cabbage, sliced radishes, fresh coriander, a little oregano and lime wedges.

picadillo-boeuf-olives-raisins.title: Ground beef picadillo with olives and raisins, rice
steps: Sauté the onion, garlic and diced bell pepper in oil for 5 minutes.
Add the ground beef, cumin, cinnamon and paprika, then brown for 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes cut into small dice, the chopped tomatoes, 150 ml of water and the salt. Cook covered for 25 minutes.
Stir in the sliced olives and the raisins, then cook for 5 minutes uncovered.
Cook the rice in twice its volume of salted water for 15 minutes, then serve with the picadillo.

galettes-quinoa-courgette-feta.title: Quinoa patties with zucchini and feta
steps: Cook the quinoa in twice its volume of salted water for 15 minutes, then let it cool.
Grate the zucchini, salt them, let them drain then squeeze them dry in a cloth. Finely slice the onion, and chop the garlic and parsley.
Mix the quinoa, zucchini, onion, garlic, parsley, eggs, flour and the crumbled feta. Season with salt and pepper.
Form patties by hand, arrange them on a tray lined with baking paper and brush them with olive oil.
Bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes, turning the patties halfway through, until they are well golden.

chou-fleur-roti-tahini-pois-chiches.title: Roasted cauliflower with tahini and chickpeas
steps: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Break the cauliflower into large florets, drizzle with a little olive oil, and sprinkle with cumin, salt and pepper.
Arrange the cauliflower on a baking sheet and roast for 25 minutes, until golden at the edges.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then sauté them in a pan with the remaining olive oil and the crushed garlic for 5 minutes.
Mix the sesame paste with the lemon juice, a little cold water and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Plate the cauliflower and the chickpeas, drizzle with the tahini sauce and scatter chopped parsley over the top.

aubergines-roties-yaourt-pois-chiches.title: Roasted eggplant with yogurt, chickpeas and zaatar
steps: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Halve the eggplants lengthwise, score the flesh in a crosshatch, and brush with olive oil, salt and cumin.
Roast the eggplants flesh-side up for 30 minutes, until very tender.
Mix the plain yogurt with the finely grated garlic, the lemon juice, salt and pepper. Chop the parsley.
Drain the chickpeas and brown them in a pan with a drizzle of olive oil for 8 minutes.
Top the eggplants with the yogurt sauce, garnish with the browned chickpeas, parsley and zaatar.

gnocchi-gratines-poireaux-comte.title: Baked gnocchi with leeks and comté
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Slice the leeks into rounds, wash them and sweat them in the butter over low heat for 10 minutes.
Add the cream, ground nutmeg, salt and pepper, then let the sauce thicken for 5 minutes over low heat.
Cook the gnocchi in a large pot of salted water until they float to the surface, then drain them.
Arrange the gnocchi in a gratin dish, cover them with the leek sauce and sprinkle with grated comté.
Bake for 15 minutes, until the cheese is golden and melted.

pates-ricotta-courgettes-citron.title: Pasta with ricotta and lemony zucchini
steps: Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water according to the time indicated on the package.
Slice the zucchini into thin rounds and brown them in a frying pan in the olive oil with the crushed garlic for 6 minutes.
Mix the ricotta with the lemon zest and juice, the grated parmesan, the salt and the pepper.
Drain the pasta, reserving some cooking water, then toss it with the zucchini, the ricotta mixture and the chopped basil, adding a little cooking water to bind.

bricks-epinards-feta.title: Spinach and feta brick pastries
steps: Thinly slice the onion and chop the garlic. Sauté them in the olive oil in a frying pan for 3 minutes, then add the fresh spinach until it wilts.
Squeeze the spinach to drain, mix it with the crumbled feta, the chopped parsley, one beaten egg, the salt and the pepper.
Cut each brick pastry sheet in half, place a spoonful of filling in the center of each half-sheet, fold and seal with the second beaten egg.
Arrange the bricks on a baking tray lined with baking paper, brush them with olive oil and bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes, until well golden.

boulettes-haricots-blancs-sauce-tomate.title: White bean herb balls in tomato sauce
steps: Drain the white beans and roughly mash them with a fork in a bowl.

Chop the onion and the garlic, then sauté them in half of the olive oil for 5 minutes. Add to the beans with the chopped parsley, the herbs, the grated parmesan, the breadcrumbs, the egg, the salt and the pepper.
Form 16 balls with wet hands, roll them in a little breadcrumbs and brown them in the remaining oil for 8 minutes.
Pour the chopped tomatoes and the tomato paste into the pan, season with salt and pepper, add the torn basil and simmer for 10 minutes with the balls.

chou-vert-braise-pommes-de-terre-paprika.title: Braised green cabbage with potatoes and paprika
steps: Remove the thick rib from the green cabbage and slice it into strips. Peel the potatoes and cut them into cubes. Finely slice the onion and the garlic.
Sauté the onion and the garlic in the olive oil for 5 minutes, then add the paprika and the sliced cabbage.
Add the potatoes, the bay leaf and the stock cube dissolved in 500 ml of hot water, then cover.
Braise covered over low heat for 30 minutes. Remove the bay leaf, stir in the crème fraîche, season with salt and pepper.

pitas-galettes-haricots-rouges-tahini.title: Pitas with red bean patties and tahini sauce
steps: Mix the chia seeds with 120 ml of soy drink and let swell.
Blend the drained red beans, the onion, the garlic, the oat flakes, the swollen chia, the cumin, the paprika, the salt and the pepper, then form 8 patties.
Brown the patties in hot olive oil for 4 minutes on each side.
Mix the sesame paste with the lemon juice, the chopped parsley and the remaining soy drink until smooth.
Fill the warm pita bread with patties, sliced tomato, shredded green salad and the tahini sauce.

socca-poivrons-oignons.title: Socca with bell peppers and onions
steps: Mix the chickpea flour, the soy drink, half of the oil, the salt, the pepper and the cumin, then let the batter rest.
Sauté the sliced onion, bell pepper and garlic in the remaining oil until soft.
Pour the batter into an oiled dish, spread the vegetables on top, then bake until the surface is golden.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley and paprika, then cut into portions with a drizzle of lemon.

ramen-tofu-champignons.title: Ramen with tofu and mushrooms
steps: Cut the firm tofu into cubes then brown it in the sesame oil for 8 minutes.
Sauté the garlic, grated fresh ginger and sliced mushrooms for 5 minutes, then add the soy sauce.
Bring water to a boil with the stock cube, then cook the noodles for 4 minutes.
Divide the noodles and fresh spinach among bowls, pour over the stock, then top with the tofu, mushrooms, sliced spring onion and sesame seeds.

bibimbap-legumes-tofu-croustillant.title: Bibimbap with vegetables and crispy tofu
steps: Rinse the rice then cook it covered for 15 minutes.
Cut the carrot and the zucchini into julienne strips, then sauté them separately in a drizzle of sesame oil for 3 minutes each.
Blanch the mung bean sprouts and the fresh spinach for 1 minute, then season with half the soy sauce, the crushed garlic and the sesame seeds.
Brown the diced tofu and the sliced button mushrooms with the chili and the remaining soy sauce for 6 minutes.
Arrange the rice in bowls with the vegetables, the tofu and the sliced spring onion.

spaghettis-lentilles-corail-basilic.title: Spaghetti with red lentils and basil
steps: Sauté the finely chopped onion and the carrot in the olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic, the tomato paste and the rinsed red lentils, then stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the chopped tomatoes, add the herbs, salt and pepper, then simmer covered for 20 minutes.
Cook the pasta in a large pot of salted water for 10 minutes, drain them then mix them with the sauce and the chopped basil.

brochettes-crevettes-harissa.title: Shrimp skewers with harissa, zucchini and bell peppers
steps: Mix the harissa, the olive oil, the crushed garlic, the lemon juice and the salt in a bowl.
Add the shrimp, the zucchini and the bell peppers cut into pieces, then marinate for 10 minutes.
Skewer the ingredients alternately and arrange them on a baking tray.
Bake for 8 minutes, turning the skewers halfway through, until the shrimp are pink.

escabeche-maquereau-carottes-laurier.title: Mackerel escabeche with carrots and bay leaf
steps: Peel the carrots and slice them into thin rounds, then thinly slice the onion.
Sauté the onion, the crushed garlic and the carrots in the olive oil for 8 minutes.
Add the vinegar, the dry white wine, the bay leaf, salt and pepper, then let simmer for 10 minutes.
Place the mackerel fillets in the marinade and cook for 5 minutes at a simmer, without boiling.
Let cool off the heat in the marinade, then chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

pates-anchois-chapelure-persil.title: Pasta with anchovy fillets, crispy breadcrumbs and parsley
steps: Cook the pasta in a large pot of salted water until al dente, then drain, reserving some cooking water.
Heat half the olive oil and brown the breadcrumbs with half the crushed garlic for 3 minutes, then set aside.
Melt the anchovy fillets in the remaining oil with the chili and the remaining garlic, crushing with a spatula for 2 minutes.
Add the drained pasta, a little cooking water, the chopped parsley and the grated parmesan, then mix.
Serve topped with the browned breadcrumbs.

cabillaud-croute-moutarde-herbes.title: Cod loin with a mustard and herb crust
steps: Preheat the oven and place the cod loin on a baking tray lined with parchment paper, seasoned with salt and pepper.
Melt the butter, then mix it with the mustard, breadcrumbs and provençal herbs. Spread this mixture over the fillets.
Bake for 12 minutes until the flesh flakes easily with a fork.
Cook the green beans in boiling salted water for 6 minutes, then serve them with the lemon cut into wedges.

cabillaud-wok-gingembre-germes-soja.title: Cod wok with ginger and mung bean sprouts
steps: Cook the rice in twice its volume of salted water until fully absorbed, then cover and set aside.
Cut the cod into large pieces, slice the spring onion and the fresh ginger, and crush the garlic.
Sear the fish in the sesame oil for 6 minutes, turning it, then set aside.
Sauté the garlic, fresh ginger and spring onion for 2 minutes, then add the mung bean sprouts and the soy sauce and cook for 3 minutes.
Return the fish to the wok, sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve over the rice.

burgers-saumon-concombre-yaourt.title: Salmon burgers with cucumber and yogurt sauce
steps: Finely chop the salmon with a knife, then mix it with the beaten egg, the breadcrumbs, the chopped chives, salt and pepper.
Form four patties and chill them for 15 minutes.
Cook the patties in the hot sunflower oil for 8 minutes, turning them, until they are golden and cooked through.
Grate the cucumber, mix it with the plain yogurt and the lemon juice and season the sauce.
Toast the burger buns, fill them with green salad, tomato slices, a patty and the sauce, then close them.

tortillas-saumon-fume-fromage-blanc.title: Tortilla wraps with smoked salmon and fresh cheese
steps: Mix the fresh cheese with the lemon juice, the chopped chives and the pepper.
Spread the sauce over each tortilla, then arrange slices of smoked salmon and slices of avocado.
Add a few leaves of green salad and roll the tortillas tightly.
Cut each roll in half on the diagonal and serve immediately.

rillettes-thon-ciboulette-toasts.title: Tuna rillettes with chives and sandwich bread toasts
steps: Drain the canned tuna and mash it with the softened butter using a fork.
Add the crème fraîche, the lemon juice, the chopped chives and the pepper, then mix until smooth.
Cut the sliced sandwich bread into triangles.
Cut the radish and the cucumber into thin rounds, then arrange them with the rillettes and the toasts.

pates-saumon-fume-petits-pois.title: Creamy pasta with smoked salmon and peas
steps: Cook the pasta in a large pot of salted water for 10 minutes, then drain, reserving a little of the cooking water.
Melt the butter and sauté the sliced shallot for 3 minutes.
Pour in the single cream, add the frozen peas and simmer for 5 minutes.
Off the heat, add the smoked salmon cut into strips, the lemon juice, the chopped parsley, the grated parmesan and the pepper, then stir in the pasta.

crevettes-chorizo-tomates-persil.title: Sautéed shrimp with chorizo, cherry tomatoes and parsley
steps: Slice the chorizo and fry it in the olive oil for 3 minutes to release its flavour.
Add the crushed garlic, chili and halved cherry tomatoes, then cook for 4 minutes.
Add the shrimp, season with salt and pepper, then cook for 3 minutes until they turn pink.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve with the baguette sliced for sopping up the juices.

pitas-cabillaud-croustillant-citron.title: Crispy cod pitas with salad and lemon sauce
steps: Cut the cod into sticks, then coat them in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs mixed with paprika.
Heat the sunflower oil in a frying pan and brown the sticks for 3 minutes on each side.
Mix the plain yogurt, lemon juice, crushed garlic, salt and pepper to make the sauce.
Warm the pita breads for 2 minutes in the oven, open them, then fill with torn green salad, the crispy sticks and the sauce.

curry-japonais-poulet-carottes.title: Japanese curry with chicken, carrots and potatoes
steps: Cut the chicken into pieces, slice the onions and chop the carrots and potatoes into large cubes.
Heat the oil with the butter, brown the chicken for 5 minutes, then add the onions and vegetables and sauté for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle with curry and flour, stir, then pour in 1 l of hot water with the stock cubes, soy sauce and honey. Simmer covered for 20 minutes.
Cook the rice in salted water for 12 minutes.
Adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper, then serve the curry with the rice.

goulasch-hongrois-boeuf-paprika.title: Hungarian goulash with beef and paprika
steps: Cut the beef into large cubes, slice the onions and cut the bell pepper into strips.
Brown the meat in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the onions and garlic and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the paprika, deglaze with the red wine, then add the tomato paste, the stock cubes dissolved in 1 l of water, the bay leaf, salt and pepper. Simmer covered for 75 minutes.
Add the potatoes cut into cubes and the bell peppers, then continue cooking covered for 25 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in the crème fraîche and serve piping hot.

salade-boulgour-saumon-fume-concombre.title: Bulgur salad with smoked salmon, cucumber and chives
steps: Pour boiling salted water over the bulgur, cover and let it swell until fully absorbed.
Dice the cucumber and the cherry tomatoes, then finely snip the chives.
Cut the smoked salmon into thin strips.
Mix the lemon juice, olive oil, salt and pepper, then dress the cooled bulgur.
Add the vegetables, the salmon and the chives to the bulgur, gently toss and serve chilled.

salade-thai-vermicelles-poulet-cacahuete.title: Thai rice vermicelli salad with chicken and peanuts
steps: Soak the rice vermicelli in a large pot of boiling water off the heat for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Cut the chicken into thin strips and brown in the sunflower oil over high heat for 6 minutes.
Peel and grate the carrot, slice the cucumber into thin ribbons and snip the fresh coriander.
Mix the lime juice, nuoc-mam, sugar and chili to prepare the dressing.
Assemble the vermicelli, the warm chicken and the vegetables, drizzle with the dressing, then sprinkle with crushed peanuts and coriander.

salade-tiede-pommes-de-terre-chorizo-poi.title: Warm potato salad with chorizo and bell peppers
steps: Cook the potatoes whole in salted boiling water for 20 minutes, then drain them, let them cool slightly and slice them into rounds.
Cut the chorizo into slices and fry it in a dry pan for 4 minutes.
Slice the bell pepper and the onion, add them to the chorizo and brown everything over medium heat for 8 minutes.
Make the dressing with the vinegar, the mustard, the olive oil, the salt and the pepper.
Toss the potatoes, the chorizo, the bell peppers, the onion and the chopped parsley with the dressing, then serve immediately.

salade-pates-poulet-curry-pomme-raisins.title: Pasta salad with chicken, curry, apple and raisins
steps: Cook the pasta in a large pot of salted boiling water according to the time indicated on the package, then rinse under cold water.
Cut the chicken into cubes and sear it in the olive oil with the curry for 8 minutes over medium heat.
Soak the raisins in a bowl of warm water for 10 minutes, then drain them.
Peel the apple, cut it into small dice and drizzle with lemon juice to prevent browning.
Mix the plain yogurt, the crème fraîche, the salt and the pepper, then combine the pasta, the chicken, the apple, the raisins and the chopped chives.

salade-endives-poire-noix-comte-lardons.title: Endive salad with pear, nuts, comté and bacon bits
steps: Fry the bacon bits in a dry pan for 5 minutes, until golden and crispy.
Roughly crush the nuts and cut the comté into thin slices.
Cut the endives into sections and slice the pear thinly.
Make the dressing with the mustard, the vinegar, the honey, the olive oil, the salt and the pepper.
Assemble the endives, the pear, the comté, the nuts and the warm bacon bits, then drizzle with the dressing.

salade-rumsteck-saisi-radis-tomates-ceri.title: Seared rump steak salad with radishes and cherry tomatoes
steps: Season the beef rump steak with salt and pepper, then sear it in very hot olive oil for 3 minutes on each side.
Let the meat rest off the heat, covered with foil, for 5 minutes.
Wash and quarter the radishes, halve the cherry tomatoes and thinly slice the spring onion.
Make the dressing with the mustard, the vinegar, the remaining olive oil and the chopped parsley.
Pick the green salad leaves, arrange them on plates with the vegetables, slice the meat thinly, then drizzle with the dressing.

soupe-crevettes-lait-coco-nouilles-riz.title: Shrimp soup with coconut milk and rice vermicelli
steps: Peel the carrot and slice it into thin rounds, slice the onion, chop the garlic and grate the fresh ginger.
Sauté the onion, the garlic, the ginger and the carrot in the oil for 5 minutes over medium heat.
Pour in the coconut milk, 1 litre of water, the stock cube, the soy sauce and the chili, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the peeled shrimp, the rice vermicelli and the mung bean sprouts, cook for 3 minutes then drizzle with the lime juice.
Serve piping hot, sprinkled with the chopped fresh coriander and lime wedges.

soupe-chorizo-pois-chiches-epinards.title: Spanish soup with chorizo, chickpeas and fresh spinach
steps: Cut the chorizo into slices, slice the onion, dice the bell pepper and the potatoes, and chop the garlic.
Fry the chorizo in the olive oil for 2 minutes, then add the onion, the garlic and the bell pepper and sweat for 5 minutes.
Add the paprika, the potatoes, the chopped tomatoes, the stock cube dissolved in 1.5 litres of water, then simmer for 20 minutes covered.
Add the drained chickpeas and the fresh spinach, cook for 5 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Serve with the chopped parsley.

soupe-boulettes-dinde-boulgour.title: Turkey meatball soup with bulgur and vegetables
steps: Finely chop the turkey escalope, slice the onion, dice the carrot and the zucchini and soak the bulgur in a bowl of hot water.
Mix the chopped turkey, drained bulgur, egg, breadcrumbs, half the chopped parsley, salt and pepper, then form small meatballs.
Bring 1.5 litres of water to a simmer with the stock cube, the tomato paste, the carrot and the onion, then add the meatballs and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the zucchini and the provençal herbs and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve sprinkled with the remaining chopped parsley.

soupe-tortilla-poulet-mais-avocat.title: Tortilla soup with chicken, corn and avocado
steps: Cut the chicken fillet into thin strips, slice the onion, chop the garlic and cut the tortilla wraps into strips.
Brown the chicken strips in the oil with the onion and the garlic for 5 minutes, then add the cumin and the paprika.
Pour in the chopped tomatoes, the drained canned corn and the dissolved stock cube in 1.5 litres of water, season with salt and simmer for 15 minutes.
Arrange the tortilla strips on a tray and brown them in the oven for 8 minutes.
Dice the avocado and drizzle with lime juice. Serve the soup with the tortilla strips, the avocado, the chopped fresh coriander and the grated cheese.

soupe-nouilles-oeuf-champignons.title: Noodle soup with soft-boiled eggs and mushrooms
steps: Plunge the eggs into boiling water for 6 minutes, then cool them in cold water and peel.
Sauté the chopped garlic, the grated ginger and the sliced mushrooms in the sesame oil for 5 minutes.
Pour in 1.5 litres of water, add the stock cubes and the soy sauce, bring to a boil, add the sliced spring onion and the fresh spinach and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles and cook for about 4 minutes according to the time indicated on the packet.
Cut the eggs in half, distribute them among the bowls with the soup and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

soupe-gnocchi-pesto-haricots-verts.title: Gnocchi soup with pesto, green beans and cherry tomatoes
steps: Slice the onion, dice the zucchini, cut the green beans into segments and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Sauté the onion and the chopped garlic in the olive oil for 4 minutes.
Pour in 1.5 litres of water with the stock cubes, bring to a boil, add the green beans and the zucchini and cook for 8 minutes.
Add the gnocchi and the cherry tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes, until the gnocchi float to the surface.
Off the heat, stir in the pesto, season with salt and pepper and serve with the grated parmesan.

velout-petits-pois-menthe.title: Creamy peas with mint
steps: Sauté the sliced onion in the olive oil until translucent.
Add the potato cut into cubes, the crumbled stock cube and one litre of hot water, then simmer covered.
Add the frozen peas and continue cooking for 5 minutes.
Blend until smooth with the mint leaves, season with salt and pepper and serve piping hot.

tartines-radis-beurre-ciboulette.title: Radish, butter and chives toasts
steps: Wash the radishes, trim the ends and slice them into thin rounds.
Generously spread each slice of bread with softened butter.
Arrange the radish rounds on the butter, then sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Chop the chives, scatter them over the toasts and serve immediately.

poivrons-grilles-ail-persil.title: Roasted bell peppers with garlic and parsley
steps: Preheat the oven to 220°C, cut the bell peppers into large strips and arrange them on a baking tray with the garlic cloves unpeeled.
Roast until the skins are slightly charred.
Let cool slightly, remove the skins and seeds, peel the garlic, then cut the flesh into pieces.
Mix with the oil, the vinegar, the chopped parsley, the salt and the pepper, then let marinate for 30 minutes before serving.

courgettes-dorees-feta-menthe.title: Golden zucchini with feta and mint
steps: Cut the zucchini into 5 mm slices and brown them in the olive oil in a frying pan, 3 minutes per side.
Arrange the zucchini in a dish, drizzle with the lemon juice, season with salt and pepper.
Crumble the feta on top and sprinkle with chopped mint.
Let rest for 10 minutes at room temperature before serving.

bouchees-feuilletees-tomates-cerises.title: Puff pastry bites with cherry tomatoes and mozzarella
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C and unroll the puff pastry onto a baking tray lined with parchment paper.
Spread the mustard over the pastry, arrange the tomatoes halved and the crumbled mozzarella on top, then season with salt, pepper and provençal herbs. Cut the pastry into 8 squares.
Bake until the edges are well golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes, sprinkle with chopped basil and serve.

carpaccio-betterave-poire-chevre.title: Beetroot, pear and goat cheese carpaccio
steps: Slice the beetroot and the pear very thinly using a sharp knife or a mandoline.
Prepare the dressing by whisking the vinegar, the mustard, the olive oil, the salt and the pepper.
Arrange the beetroot and pear slices in a rosette on plates, crumble the goat cheese and sprinkle the nuts on top.
Drizzle with the dressing and serve at room temperature.

champignons-sautes-ail-persil.title: Sautéed button mushrooms with garlic and parsley
