steps: Heat the butter and oil in a large frying pan, then sauté the sliced button mushrooms over high heat for 8 minutes.
Add the chopped garlic and the chopped parsley, then cook for another 1 minute while stirring.
Season with salt and pepper.
Toast the slices of country bread and top them with the mushrooms before serving hot.

choux-bruxelles-roties-miel-noix.title: Roasted brussels sprouts with honey and nuts
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C, cut the brussels sprouts in half and arrange them on a baking tray with the oil, the salt and the pepper.
Roast until well browned and tender.
Toast the chopped nuts dry in a pan for 3 minutes.
Drizzle the sprouts with honey, sprinkle with the nuts and serve hot.

endives-braisees-orange.title: Braised endives with orange
steps: Melt the butter in a sauté pan, sprinkle with sugar, then sauté the endives halved for 5 minutes.
Add the orange juice, the peeled orange segments, salt and pepper, then cover and braise over low heat.
Remove the lid and let the juices caramelize for 5 minutes.
Serve hot, spooned with its juices.

poireaux-vinaigrette-oeufs-durs.title: Leeks with vinaigrette and hard-boiled eggs
steps: Cook the whole leeks in boiling salted water for 20 minutes.
Cook the eggs for 9 minutes in a separate saucepan, then peel them.
Drain the leeks and let them cool for 10 minutes.
Whisk the vinegar, mustard, olive oil, salt and pepper, then drizzle over the leeks.
Serve cold, accompanied by the eggs cut into quarters.

tartinade-feves-menthe-pitas.title: Fava bean and mint spread with grilled pitas
steps: Drain and rinse the fava beans, then blend them with the garlic clove, the lemon juice, olive oil, cumin and salt.
Add the chopped mint leaves and blend until smooth.
Cut the pita bread into triangles and dry-grill them in a hot pan.
Serve the spread with the grilled pita triangles.

tartelettes-epinards-ciboulette.title: Spring tartlets with spinach and chives
steps: Wilt the spinach in a hot pan for 3 minutes, then drain and chop it.
Preheat the oven to 180°C and line four small molds with the shortcrust pastry.
Beat the eggs with the cream, ground nutmeg, salt, pepper and the chopped chives, then add the spinach and the grated cheese.
Divide the mixture among the molds, bake for 30 minutes, then let stand for 10 minutes before unmolding.

tartinade-betterave-chevre-noix.title: Beetroot, goat cheese and walnut spread
steps: Blend the cooked beetroot cut into cubes with the goat cheese, the peeled garlic, olive oil and vinegar.
Season with salt and pepper, then blend until smooth.
Roughly chop the nuts with a knife.
Serve the spread in a bowl and sprinkle with the chopped nuts.

tartinade-haricots-blancs-citron-persil.title: White bean spread with lemon and parsley
steps: Drain and rinse the white beans, then blend them with the peeled garlic, the lemon juice, olive oil and cumin.
Salt, pepper and blend again until creamy.
Add the chopped parsley, mix and serve well chilled.

rillettes-sardines-citron-ciboulette.title: Rillettes of sardines with lemon and chives
steps: Mash the drained sardines with the softened butter and the lemon juice using a fork.
Add the chopped chives, season lightly with salt and pepper and mix.
Chill to allow the flavors to develop.
Serve on thin slices or in a bowl with a wedge of lemon.

bouchees-feuilletees-jambon-moutarde-com.title: Puff pastry bites with cooked ham, mustard and comté
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C and cut the puff pastry into squares about 8 cm each.
Spread mustard on each square, top with shredded cooked ham and grated comté, then fold to form bites.
Beat the egg with a pinch of salt, brush the bites and bake for 15 minutes until deeply golden.
Let rest for a few minutes before serving.

tartinade-saumon-fume-fromage-blanc.title: Smoked salmon spread with fromage blanc
steps: Finely chop the smoked salmon with a knife.
Mix the salmon with the fromage blanc, the lemon juice, the chopped chives and the pepper.
Serve immediately or keep chilled until serving.

batons-polenta-parmesan-herbes.title: Crispy polenta sticks with parmesan
steps: Bring 1 litre of water to a boil with the stock cube, then whisk in the polenta in a steady stream.
Cook for 5 minutes over medium heat, stirring constantly, then stir in the grated parmesan, the provençal herbs, salt and pepper.
Spread the polenta in an oiled dish to a thickness of 2 cm and chill until set.
Cut into sticks and brown them in hot olive oil, 3 minutes per side.

galettes-courgette-feta-menthe.title: Zucchini, feta and mint patties
steps: Grate the zucchinis, salt them and let drain for 10 minutes in a colander.
Squeeze the zucchinis in a cloth, then mix with the eggs, the flour, the baking powder, the chopped mint and the crumbled feta. Add pepper.
Fry spoonfuls of batter in hot sunflower oil, 3 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm.

tartines-olives-anchois-toasts.title: Olive and anchovy spread on toasts
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C and slice the baguette on the diagonal.
Blend the pitted olives, the drained anchovy fillets, the peeled garlic and the olive oil until coarsely combined.
Add the oregano and a pinch of pepper, then mix.
Arrange the baguette slices on a tray and grill for 5 minutes in the oven.
Spread the mixture on the toasts while still warm and serve immediately.

bouchees-quinoa-chevre-carotte.title: Quinoa, carrot and goat cheese bites baked in the oven
steps: Cook the quinoa in 300 ml of salted water for 15 minutes, then drain it.
Grate the carrots and mix them into the warm quinoa with the beaten eggs, the crumbled goat cheese, the breadcrumbs, the cumin and the pepper.
Form 16 balls, brush them with olive oil and arrange them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes, turning the bites halfway through cooking.

tartinade-patate-douce-tahini.title: Roasted sweet potato spread with sesame paste
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C, cut the sweet potatoes in half, brush them with 1 tbsp of olive oil then place them cut side down.
Roast for 40 minutes until the flesh is tender, then scoop it out with a spoon.
Blend the flesh with the sesame paste, the juice of the lemon, the peeled garlic, the paprika, the salt, the pepper and the second tablespoon of olive oil.
Serve warm or cold.

beignets-crevettes-coco-citron-vert.title: Peeled shrimp fritters with grated coconut and lime
steps: Roughly chop the peeled shrimp and cut them into small pieces.
Mix the flour, the egg, the milk, the zest and juice of the lime, the grated coconut, the grated fresh ginger, the chili, the salt and the shrimp.
Spoon small patties and fry them in hot sunflower oil, 2 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels and serve immediately.

tartinade-feves-menthe-citron.title: Fava bean spread with mint and lemon
steps: Rinse the drained fava beans and blend them with the peeled garlic, the juice of the lemon, half of the mint leaves and the olive oil.
Add the cumin, salt, pepper and blend until smooth.
Toast the slices of country bread in a dry pan, 2 minutes per side.
Spread the mixture on the slices and top with the remaining chopped mint.

clafoutis-poires-amandes.title: Pear and almond clafoutis
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Peel the pears, cut them into thin wedges and arrange them in a buttered dish.
Mix the flour, the sugar and the vanilla sugar, then add the beaten eggs and the milk to obtain a smooth batter.
Pour the batter over the pears, sprinkle with the flaked almonds and bake.
Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.

far-breton-pruneaux.title: Far Breton with pitted prunes
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and butter a tart dish.
Whisk the eggs with the sugar, add the flour and the vanilla sugar, then pour in the milk little by little while stirring.
Spread the pitted prunes in the dish, pour the batter over them and bake.
Let cool slightly before unmolding or serving warm.

creme-citron-legere.title: Light lemon cream
steps: Squeeze the lemons and reserve the zest.
In a saucepan, whisk the eggs with the sugar, the juice and the zest, then add the butter cut into pieces.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until thickened, about 8 minutes, without letting it boil.
Let cool, fold in the whipped cream and chill.

pommes-four-speculoos.title: Baked apples filled with speculoos
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Core the apples, keeping the base intact.
Crush the speculoos with the melted butter, the honey and the cinnamon.
Fill the apples with this mixture, arrange them in a dish and bake.
Serve warm straight from the oven.

brownies-aux-noix.title: Walnut brownies
steps: Preheat the oven to 170 °C and line a square baking tin.
Melt the dark chocolate and the butter in a bain-marie, then let cool slightly.
Add the sugar and the eggs one at a time, then the flour, the cocoa powder and the chopped nuts.
Pour the batter into the tin and bake for 25 minutes, until the center is still slightly gooey. Cool before cutting into squares.

semoule-lait-fleur-oranger.title: Semolina pudding with orange blossom
steps: Heat the milk with the butter and the sugar over medium heat.
Pour the semolina in a thin stream while stirring, add the raisins and let thicken.
Off the heat, flavor with the orange blossom water.
Divide into bowls and chill.

iles-flottantes-vanille.title: Vanilla floating islands
steps: Separate the egg whites from the yolks.
Whip the egg whites with 90 g of sugar until stiff, then form meringue quenelles using a spoon.
Bring the milk to a simmer in a large saucepan and poach the meringue quenelles for 1 minute on each side. Remove and set aside.
Beat the yolks with the remaining sugar and the vanilla sugar, pour in the warm cooking milk, then cook over low heat, stirring, until the custard coats the back of a spoon.
Pour the custard into serving dishes, top with the islands and chill.

truffes-coco-chocolat.title: Coconut chocolate truffles
steps: Heat the heavy cream, pour it over the chopped chocolate and stir until you obtain a smooth ganache.
Add the butter cut into pieces and the vanilla sugar, then mix well.
Refrigerate the ganache for 2 hours until firm.
Shape into balls, then roll them in the grated coconut mixed with the cocoa powder.

beignets-pommes-cannelle.title: Apple fritters with cinnamon
steps: Mix the flour, baking powder, 40 g of sugar and the cinnamon.
Add the eggs and the milk to obtain a smooth batter, then let it rest.
Peel the apples, cut them into thin rings and dip them in the batter.
Fry the rings in oil heated to about 170 °C, 3 minutes per side.
Drain on absorbent paper and roll the fritters in the remaining sugar.

tarte-chocolat-framboises.title: Chocolate and raspberry tart
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and line a tin with the shortcrust pastry.
Spread the frozen raspberries over the pastry base.
Heat the cream, pour it over the chopped dark chocolate, then fold in the beaten eggs and the sugar.
Pour the filling over the raspberries and bake until the custard is set. Let cool slightly before serving.

glace-yaourt-fruits-rouges.title: Quick yogurt and mixed berry ice cream
steps: Blend the frozen berries with the sugar and the lemon juice until you obtain a purée.
Whisk the cold cream until it holds, then fold in the plain yogurts.
Mix the fruit purée into the cream, pour into a mould and freeze for at least 4 hours.
Remove the ice cream from the freezer 10 minutes before serving.

bananes-poelees-beurre-cannelle.title: Pan-fried bananas with butter and cinnamon, whipped cream
steps: Whip the cold cream with 20 g of sugar until you obtain stiff peaks, then keep chilled.
Peel the bananas and cut them into thick slices.
Melt the butter in a frying pan over medium heat, add the bananas and the remaining sugar, and let brown.
Sprinkle with cinnamon, caramelize for 2 minutes, then plate the bananas with the whipped cream.

truffes-chocolat-cacao.title: Dark chocolate truffles with cocoa
steps: Heat the cream in a saucepan over low heat until it begins to simmer, then pour it over the chopped dark chocolate.
Stir in the butter in pieces and mix until you obtain a smooth ganache.
Let cool then refrigerate the ganache for 1 hour.
Scoop out spoonfuls, roll them into balls and coat them in cocoa powder; keep chilled.

energy-balls-beurre-cacahuete.title: Peanut butter and chocolate energy balls
steps: Mix the oat flakes, the peanut butter and the honey in a bowl.
Chop the dark chocolate and fold it into the mixture.
Form walnut-sized balls with your hands.
Roll the balls in the grated coconut.
Refrigerate the balls for 30 minutes so they hold together.

creme-ricotta-pistaches-miel.title: Ricotta cream with pistachios and honey
steps: Squeeze the lemon to obtain about 2 tablespoons of juice.
Whisk the ricotta with the honey, sugar and lemon juice until smooth and creamy.
Roughly chop the shelled pistachios.
Divide the cream among four small bowls, sprinkle with pistachios and refrigerate for 30 minutes before serving.

carpaccio-ananas-citron-vert-menthe.title: Pineapple carpaccio with lime and mint
steps: Peel the pineapple, remove the core and slice the flesh very thinly.
Squeeze the limes to obtain their juice.
Arrange the pineapple slices in a circle on a large platter, sprinkle with sugar and drizzle with lime juice.
Chop the mint, scatter it over the carpaccio and let macerate in the fridge for 30 minutes.

fraises-vin-blanc-menthe.title: Strawberries marinated in white wine and mint
steps: Wash the strawberries, remove the stems and halve the larger ones.
Heat the white wine with the sugar over medium heat until the sugar is completely dissolved.
Let the syrup cool for 30 minutes.
Pour the syrup over the strawberries, add the chopped mint and let macerate in the fridge for 1 hour.

semifreddo-framboise.title: Raspberry semifreddo with mascarpone
steps: Blend the thawed raspberries with 30 g of sugar then pass the purée through a sieve to remove the seeds.
Whip the single cream cold with the mascarpone, the remaining sugar and the vanilla sugar until it holds.
Gently fold the raspberry purée into the cream to create marbling.
Pour the mixture into a loaf pan lined with plastic wrap and freeze for at least 6 hours before unmolding.

sorbet-mangue-citron-vert.title: Mango and lime sorbet without an ice cream maker
steps: Peel the mangoes, remove the flesh from the stone and cut into pieces.
Squeeze the limes to obtain their juice.
Blend the mango with the lime juice, the orange juice and the sugar until smooth.
Pour into a dish and freeze for 4 hours, scraping with a fork every 45 minutes.

salami-chocolat-speculoos.title: Chocolate salami with speculoos and peanuts
steps: Crush the speculoos with a rolling pin inside a plastic bag.
Melt the butter with the dark chocolate in a bain-marie over low heat, stirring.
Roughly chop the peanuts and mix them with the speculoos into the melted chocolate.
Shape into a log on a sheet of baking paper, wrap and refrigerate for 2 hours before slicing.

ecorces-chocolat-fruits-secs.title: Dark chocolate bark with dried fruits
steps: Melt the dark chocolate broken into pieces in a bain-marie over low heat.
Spread the melted chocolate in a layer about 5 mm thick on a baking sheet lined with baking paper.
Coarsely chop the dried apricots and the shelled pistachios, then sprinkle them with the flaked almonds and the raisins.
Let the barks set in the fridge for 30 minutes before breaking them into pieces.

cheesecake-sans-cuisson-framboises.title: No‑bake cheesecake with berry coulis
steps: Crush the speculoos biscuits, melt the butter and mix the two, then press the mixture into the base of a springform pan.
Whisk the mascarpone with the fromage blanc, 60 g of sugar and the lemon juice until smooth.
Whip the cold single cream into whipped cream with the remaining sugar, then gently fold it into the mixture.
Pour the cream over the speculoos base, smooth and refrigerate for 4 hours.
Heat the frozen berries with a little sugar for 5 minutes, let cool, then spoon the coulis over the cheesecake when serving.

nice-cream-banane-cacao.title: Banana nice cream with cocoa and peanut butter
steps: Peel the bananas, cut them into rounds and freeze for 2 hours on a baking sheet lined with baking paper.
Blend the frozen banana rounds with the cocoa, the honey and the coconut milk until you obtain an ice-cream-like texture.
Serve immediately, adding a spoonful of peanut butter to each portion.

polenta-sucree-poire-miel.title: Sweet polenta with pear and honey
steps: Peel the pear, cut it into small dice then sauté in a frying pan with the butter and the cinnamon.
Bring the milk and the salt to a boil, pour the polenta in a thin stream while whisking, then cook over low heat for 5 minutes, stirring.
Add the honey, mix, divide into bowls and top with the warm pears.

chaussons-pomme-cannelle.title: Apple and cinnamon turnovers
steps: Peel the apples, cut them into small dice then sauté in a frying pan with the butter, the sugar and the cinnamon for 8 minutes.
Let the filling cool for 10 minutes, then unroll the puff pastry and cut it into four squares.
Place a spoonful of filling in the centre of each square, fold into a triangle and seal the edges with a fork.
Brush with the beaten egg yolk then bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes until the turnovers are golden.

wraps-oeuf-epinards-fromage.title: Scrambled egg, spinach and cheese wraps
steps: Heat the olive oil in a frying pan, add the fresh spinach and let it wilt for 3 minutes over medium heat.
Beat the eggs with the salt and the pepper, pour them into the pan then gently scramble for 3 minutes.
Distribute the mixture over the warm tortilla wraps, sprinkle with the grated cheese, fold the sides then roll up.
Brown the wraps for 2 minutes on each side in a clean frying pan.

muffins-carotte-noix.title: Carrot and walnut muffins
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C, grate the carrots finely and roughly chop the walnuts.
Beat the eggs with the sugar, add the oil then the grated carrot.
Fold in the flour, the baking powder and the cinnamon, then the walnuts, mixing only until combined.
Spoon the batter into muffin tins and bake for 25 minutes at 180 °C until a skewer comes out clean.

tartines-fromage-blanc-radis.title: Fresh white cheese, radish and chives toasts
steps: Wash and slice the radishes thinly.
Mix the fromage blanc with the chopped chives, salt and pepper.
Toast the slices of bread in a dry pan for 3 minutes per side, then drizzle with a little olive oil.
Spread each slice with the fromage blanc, top with radishes and serve immediately.

gaufres-yaourt-fruits-rouges.title: Yogurt waffles with berries
steps: Melt the butter, then in a bowl mix the flour, the baking powder and 30 g of sugar.
Add the eggs, the plain yogurts, the milk and the vanilla extract, then mix until you have a smooth batter.
Melt the frozen berries in a saucepan over low heat with the remaining 10 g of sugar for 5 minutes.
Heat the waffle iron, pour a ladle of batter and cook for about 4 minutes per waffle.
Serve the waffles warm topped with the berry sauce.

galettes-patate-douce-oeuf.title: Sweet potato cakes with fried eggs
steps: Grate the sweet potato and the onion, press to remove excess water, then mix with the paprika, salt and pepper.
Shape four cakes, pressing them firmly, then brown them for 5 minutes per side in hot oil.
Crack an egg onto each cake, cover and cook for 4 minutes until the whites are set.
Sprinkle with chopped chives and serve immediately.
